lines.text: Stock-back rewards get paid on purchases that can still be refunded.
Zen makes every reward a locked equity claim, and builds the market that prices the refund risk. Live on Monad.
A merchant issues a signed receipt.
The shopper signs up with a passkey. No wallet, no seed phrase. Mera derives a Monad account, funded in seconds.
The signature checks out, and the reward is minted as a conditional claim: equity in escrow until the return window closes.
The seal fills as the window runs.
Don't want to wait? Cash out now. The pool prices the refund risk and pays on the spot.
One transaction on Monad. The shopper is paid, and the pool takes the claim.
Now the item comes back. The merchant signs a refund, the claim is voided, and the equity returns to the brand.
The pool books the loss it priced in. Consumer refund risk, traded onchain.
Every event streams through Envio HyperSync, in milliseconds.
The same passkey derives a second key that encrypts your receipts. Only you can open your proof of purchase.
Zen. Every stock-back reward, settled on Monad.
